anchors.paper_title: Affective Calibration of Musical Feature Sets in an Emotionally Intelligent Music Composition System
anchors.reason: Paper describes calibrating musical feature sets for the BCMI-MIdAS music generator via listener ratings, not the EEG recordings in this dataset (which accompanies Daly et al. 2018).
README says the dataset accompanies Daly et al. (2018) and was only 'analysed in' Daly et al. (2016); this 2016 aBCMI paper is an analysis paper, not the designated data paper.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded at 1 kHz sampling rate from 8 participants during a music listening task. Each trial consisted of a 60-second music clip: the first 20 seconds targeted an initial affective state (target A), followed by 20 seconds during which the BCMI system identified the participant's current affective state and generated music to transition toward a second target state (target B), with the final 20 seconds targeting the second affective state. Participants provided subjective ratings of valence and arousal following each clip.
